metadata.case_name: CHENG LIU NEI SU v. CLARE ENVIRONMENTAL SERVICES LTD

injuries.description: soft tissue injury / contusion of the back and buttocks with residual pain
source: she fell off the ladder, landing on her buttocks and back.
some soft tissue injury but there was no major structural damage to the back.
soft tissue injury with residual pain
residual pain on the back soft tissue contusion injury is 3 per cent impairment of the whole person
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of lower back or pelvis

injuries.description: adjustment disorder with depressed mood / depression
source: About six months after the accident, she developed mental depression due to the residual back pain which affected her sleep and well-being.
they agreed Madam Cheng suffered from adjustment disorder with depressed mood.
Dr Lau assessed her psychiatric impairment to be 1%.

manifestations.description: low mood, crying episodes, insomnia, reduced appetite, inertia and anergia
social and marital relationships were also affected
could not return to her old job

treatments_received: taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital by ambulance at around 6 pm. After examination and diagnosis by the accident and emergency doctors, she was treated and discharged home.
followed up at the Robert Black General Outpatients Clinic
followed up at the Queen Elizabeth Hospital Orthopaedics Department
subsequently, she received physiotherapy and occupational therapy treatments at the Queen Elizabeth Hospital
treatment at the East Kowloon Psychiatric Centre with medications
treatments_future: consultation at the public sector at the East Kowloon Psychiatric Centre

losses.description: her social and marital relationships were also affected
she accepted that she could not return to her old job
